title: Symplectic Lie groups and nilmanifolds associated with acyclic quivers
summary: We give combinatorial criteria for the existence of left-invariant symplectic forms on the positive and full path Lie groups of finite acyclic quivers. For the nilpotent positive path Lie groups, the criterion also determines whether their compact quotients admit symplectic forms and forces the nilpotency step to be at most three. For the completely solvable full path Lie groups, we give a direct combinatorial criterion and an equivalent recursive criterion.
